papers.evidence: 速率匹配格兰杰因果关联脑体信号
papers.tldr: 针对脑体信号采样率差异大、时间尺度跨毫秒至分钟且存在未测共同影响的问题，本文提出率匹配格兰杰因果（RMGC），无需统一采样网格即可估计有向预测关系，并为每个关系提供鲁棒性值以量化最弱共同影响。神经扩展可检测非线性关系。基准测试中RMGC恢复真实关系92%（假阳性率5%），优于四种现有方法和共同网格模型；在睡眠与清醒数据中揭示了脑-心关系，并区分了可被共同驱动重现的关系。
papers.abstract_en: Simultaneous brain and body recordings combine signals sampled at very different rates with processes that act on timescales from milliseconds to minutes. Placing all signals on one time grid can distort the directed relationships estimated from them. Unmeasured common influences can also make one signal appear to drive another. We introduce rate-matched Granger causality (RMGC), which estimates directed predictive relationships without a common sampling grid. Each relationship receives a robustness value, the strength of the weakest common influence found within a specified class that can reproduce it. A neural extension tests for nonlinear relationships. In a controlled benchmark, RMGC recovered more true relationships than four established methods and an autoregressive model on a common grid (92\% at a false-positive rate of 5\%). Given the same signal features, the common-grid model matched this recovery but had more than twice the false-positive rate, and it reversed the relationship from respiration to heart rate. The robustness value never overstated the strength of the driver behind a spurious relationship, even for drivers outside the searched class. It separated true from spurious relationships better than predictive strength did. In overnight sleep recordings and two awake datasets, many brain--heart relationships could be reproduced by common drivers no stronger than measured respiration. Robustness values only partly identified those that appeared when respiration was omitted, particularly during wakefulness. Surrogate analyses showed elevated background rates in one awake dataset. The approach applies to other signals recorded at different rates or as events, provided that influences act with a delay.

papers.title_en: EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG
papers.authors: Zhifei Zhu, Hongtao Zhang, Yu Ren, Wei Zhou, Zeping Xie, Yi He
papers.tldr: 针对脑电分析中需同时处理选择、判断与评分任务且要求可校准概率的问题，论文提出统一单遍决策模型 EEG-Jev。该模型一次前向即可按答案规格输出类型化结果，并在35个公开数据集的留出划分上联合训练与评估，取得睡眠分期70.45%、癫痫检测AUROC 0.825等性能，且校准后负对数似然降低、推理延迟减半。
papers.abstract_en: EEG analysis spans choosing alternatives, judging statements, and rating ordered attributes, requiring calibratable probabilities with explicit meaning. We present EEG-Jev, a unified single-pass decision model for EEG. Given an EEG window, a question and an answer specification, one forward pass returns a typed readout: CHOICE gives a candidate distribution, NOUL a proposition probability, and SCORE an ordered-level distribution and expectation. One checkpoint is trained jointly and evaluated once on held-out splits of 35 public sources. Core raw outputs reach 54.08% balanced accuracy on Stieger2021 motor imagery, 70.45% on Sleep-EDF-SC sleep staging, 72.11% per window at threshold 0.5 on CHB-MIT seizure detection with 0.825 AUROC, and 1.700 MAE on 0-10 ds005292 pain ratings. Prior correction and temperature scaling lower negative log-likelihood from 0.766 to 0.606 on Sleep-EDF-SC and 0.166 to 0.019 on CHB-MIT, while direct readout cuts batch-1 latency from 122.43 to 63.11 ms (1.94-fold) against a matched-backbone generative comparator. Interactive demonstration and aggregate results: https://neuroimglab.github.io/EEG-Jev/.

papers.title_en: Concept Generalization in Visual Brain Decoding via Encoder-Generated fMRI
papers.authors: Peter Yongho Kim, Juhyeon Park, Dongsheng Li, Yansen Wang, Dongqi Han, Mingqing Xiao, Taesup Moon
papers.evidence: 视觉脑解码，fMRI到图像重建
papers.tldr: 视觉脑解码器对训练中未见的语义概念泛化能力较差，而脑编码器对语义保留更稳健。本文提出利用脑编码器为新图像生成合成fMRI响应，并将其加入解码器训练数据。在三个解码器、四个受试者和十二个语义概念上，该方法无需额外fMRI采集即可恢复大部分因概念保留而损失的性能，并提升不同数据预算下的一般解码性能，表明编码器生成的fMRI能传递语义泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Visual brain decoders are typically trained and evaluated on stimuli drawn from similar semantic distributions, leaving their ability to reconstruct unseen concepts poorly understood. We study this concept generalization problem by withholding semantic concepts from a target subject's training data. We find that three recent fMRI-to-image decoders degrade substantially for the held-out concepts, even when the concept remains available for multi-subject models. In contrast, brain encoders that map a pretrained visual representation directly to voxels are markedly more robust to the same semantic holdout. Motivated by this asymmetry, we use such an encoder to generate synthetic fMRI responses for new images and add the resulting image-fMRI pairs to decoder training. Across three decoders, four subjects, and twelve semantic concepts, synthetic data recovers a substantial fraction of the performance lost on unseen concepts without requiring additional, time-consuming fMRI acquisition. We further show that the same approach improves general decoding performance across a wide range of data budgets. Analyses of encoder training conditions, encoder designs, and synthetic-data controls show that the gains depend on both encoder generalization and the semantic content of the synthetic supervision, rather than merely increasing the amount of training data. Together, our results show that encoder-generated fMRI can transfer semantic generalization to decoders.

papers.title_en: HSTTA: Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Hongzhou Chen, Yuhao Wei, Lianghua He, Yihang Liu, Zengqiang Wang
papers.evidence: 提出跨被试EEG图像检索的层次选择性测试时自适应方法
papers.tldr: 跨受试者EEG到图像检索因主体偏移性能下降，现有测试时适应难以匹配查询置信度导致伪标签不可靠。本文提出HSTTA框架，利用层次选择性预测为每个EEG查询分配适应的监督粒度，并设计跨会话一致性校准和互惠层次回退机制。在THINGS-EEG2等基准上，HSTTA显著超越最强基线，Top-1/Top-5准确率提升17.9和8.9个百分点，伪标签更准确。
papers.abstract_en: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval suffers from substantial performance degradation on new subjects due to subject shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this shift by adapting pretrained models with unlabeled target-subject EEG. However, most existing TTA methods struggle to match supervision granularity to each query's prediction confidence, leaving many queries without reliable pseudo-labels. To address this, we propose a novel framework named Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation (HSTTA). HSTTA builds a hierarchy over gallery image embeddings, uses hierarchical selective prediction to assign each EEG query a supervision granularity matching its current prediction confidence, and constructs adaptation objectives accordingly. We further propose Cross-Session Consistency Calibration (CSCC), an unsupervised method that calibrates the global confidence threshold to target a predefined accuracy level for hierarchical predictions. Moreover, we introduce Reciprocal Hierarchical Backoff (RHB), which moves queries lacking reverse-matching support to coarser nodes to mitigate error reinforcement. Experiments on two public benchmarks and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of HSTTA and its key components. On THINGS-EEG2, HSTTA outperforms the strongest EEG-specific TTA baseline by 17.9 (13.4) and 8.9 (3.7) percentage points in Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, respectively, under cosine (CSLS) ranking. Further analyses show that HSTTA yields more accurate pseudo-labels during adaptation, supporting more reliable model updates.

papers.title_en: Technical Report MEG2text: Beyond Alignment in Non-Invasive Brain-to-Text
papers.evidence: MEG2text从非侵入式MEG脑活动解码语言
papers.tldr: 非侵入性脑到文本面临将脑-语言表示转为词预测的挑战。本文提出MEG2text系统，融合修正训练评估、脑-文本对齐、类别平衡读出和语言模型，在LibriBrain100词排序任务上平均Top-10平衡准确率64.12%，较MEG-XL提升16.92个百分点，表明解码规则改进能更好利用对齐特征。
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive brain-to-text seeks to recover language from brain activity without surgery. A central challenge is turning learned brain-language representations into accurate word predictions. We present MEG2text, a decoding system that combines corrected training and evaluation, brain-text alignment, a class-balanced word readout, and target-word language-model fusion. On LibriBrain100's word-ranking task, MEG2text reaches 64.12% mean Top-10 balanced accuracy, improving on published MEG-XL by 16.92 percentage points across four corpora, with gains on each corpus. Controlled comparisons show that both implementation corrections and a learned readout contribute to this improvement. Candidate-level analysis reveals that some words receive informative scores yet consistently lose to competing candidates, while an identical-feature comparison shows that learning the classification rule improves decoding without changing the representation. These findings identify the decoding rule as a consequential part of non-invasive brain-to-text and show how system improvements can make better use of aligned neural features.

papers.title_en: Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview
papers.authors: Frédéric Li Combeau, Nicolas Michel, Toshihiko Yamasaki
papers.evidence: 提出带域预览的持续学习方法处理域偏移
papers.tldr: 针对训练和测试阶段均需适应领域偏移的场景，提出CL-P设置。现有TTA会损害刚训练域并增加遗忘，主要因共享BatchNorm统计。提出DOSE方法，通过在线统计各域进行自适应域推断，按图像来自preview域的概率施加适应，无缝结合CL和TTA。实验表明在24个设置中匹配或优于单独CL方法，在除一个外的所有naive组合中匹配或优于。
papers.abstract_en: Domain shift is a major problem for training machine learning models. While Continual Learning (CL) assumes distribution shift during training and Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) considers new domains at test time, setups that require explicit online adaptation to domain shift during both phases remain under-explored. We propose continual learning with domain preview (CL-P), a new combination of CL and TTA where both train and test data suffer from distribution shift. The training phase of CL-P is analogous to domain-incremental learning while the testing phase consists of a TTA phase on a future domain (which we call preview), and an evaluation phase on all seen domains. The model must then adapt to new domains at train and test time. In this paper, we evaluate mainstream CL and TTA methods that adapt only at train or test time, as well as their naive combination. Experimentally, TTA heavily damages the domain on which the CL method has just trained and increases forgetting. Notably, this damage mostly comes from the BatchNorm statistics shared by all domains. In that sense, we propose DOSE (Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain), which allows a seamless combination of any CL and TTA methods by adaptive domain inference at test time, where the adaptation is applied to each image in proportion to the probability that it comes from the preview domain. Through extensive experiments with ResNet and ViT backbones, various combinations of CL and TTA baseline methods and datasets considering diverse domains, we show that DOSE matches or improves on CL methods alone in all 24 settings and on the naive combination in all but one. The code can be found in appendix.

papers.title_en: Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis
papers.authors: Yujie Zhang, Tianyi Zhao, Guanghui Min, Chen Chen
papers.evidence: 神经网络机制可解释性电路发现方法
papers.tldr: 机制可解释性中电路发现通常依赖提示对和因果干预，脆弱且受提示设计影响。本文提出梯度谱分析SCA，利用前向梯度谱结构，无需反事实干预，通过块级SVD提取任务子空间并分配谱能量到单元，实现跨输入表述稳定、跨任务共享的电路发现。在GPT-2 Small和Pythia-160M上性能与EAP相当或更优，并能统一跨任务分析。
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks by identifying small, faithful subgraphs--circuits--that implement specific behaviors. The dominant paradigm scores each unit by replacing its clean activation with a corrupted counterpart as causal intervention. While effective, this approach rests on a brittle prerequisite: the structure prompt pairs are task-specific, expensive to engineer, and silently couple the discovered circuit to prompt-design choices. In this work, we propose Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA), a gradient-spectral pipeline that achieves consistent circuit discovery along both axes: stable across input formulations of the same task, and natively exposing structure shared across tasks. Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a counterfactual-free reframing of circuit discovery: causally relevant directions are recoverable from the spectral structure of forward gradients across paraphrases, with leading directions concentrating task signal and trailing ones absorbing paraphrase noise, yielding circuits tied to the task rather than the prompt. Second, we introduce SCA, a block-wise SVD pipeline that extracts a task subspace per architectural block and redistributes spectral energy onto constituent units via a consistency-weighted share, producing per-unit rankings competitive with attribution-patching baselines under strictly less supervision. Finally, on twelve circuit-discovery tasks in GPT-2 Small and Pythia-160M, SCA performs comparably or exceeds EAP-family methods under the standard recovery-score protocol and recovers IOI canonical heads with Precision@K = 1.0 in top-10 slices on GPT-2 Small; the same machinery extends to a unified cross-task analysis classifying units as universal, family-shared, or task-specific and exposing compositional structure invisible to per-task analyses.

papers.title_en: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
papers.authors: Yiming Sun, Yifan Wang, Aosong Feng, Yijia Ma, Ben Cheng, Xurui Wang, Yufan He, Yucheng Tang, Qing Lyu, Daguang Xu, Pei-Fen Kuan, Mingzhou Ding, Wen Li, Chenyu You
papers.tldr: 本文针对EEG到fMRI的跨模态合成问题，提出神经血管编码（Neurovascular Codes）作为共享EEG表示。方法先训练多个EEG编码器分别预测不同fMRI信号，冻结后拼接隐藏特征投影到共享编码，再以随机插值从噪声生成fMRI信号，支持同一EEG窗口采样多样响应。在8个同时EEG-fMRI数据集共61,646对样本上，该方法相比最强编码器和生成器基线显著提升相关性与被试识别准确率，为跨模态脑建模开辟新方向。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. We first train a separate EEG encoder to predict each fMRI signal, learning target-specific temporal and spectral features from the same EEG window. After training, we freeze the encoders and project their concatenated hidden features into a shared neurovascular code. Conditioned on this code, stochastic interpolant transforms Gaussian noise into a vector of fMRI signals, allowing different responses to be sampled for the same EEG window. We evaluate our approach on eight public simultaneous EEG-fMRI datasets, including four resting-state and four task-based datasets with 61,646 volume-level pairs. Under within-subject and held-out-subject evaluation, our model improves average Pearson correlation over the strongest encoder baselines by 19.1% and 19.8%, respectively. The corresponding improvements over the strongest generator baselines are 18.8% and 47.9%. Beyond reconstruction accuracy, we also evaluate the generated signals using subject-identification classifiers trained on real fMRI. Our method achieves the highest mean accuracy among the evaluated generators. We hope that our work opens up new opportunities for cross-modal brain modeling.

papers.title_en: DUST: Directional Uncertainty-aware and Scale-invariant Transfer Learning
papers.evidence: 跨域回归的具有不确定性和尺度不变性的迁移学习方法
papers.tldr: 迁移学习通过借用源数据提升目标回归效率，但现有方法依赖源参数点估计且对尺度敏感，缺乏不确定性考量。本文提出DUST，将源回归估计的抽样分布投影到单位球面得到尺度不变方向分布，并通过角锥先验将目标参数收缩到高概率方向，幅度仅由目标数据学习，实现尺度不变且不确定性感知的鲁棒迁移，且后验计算可处理。
papers.abstract_en: Transfer learning seeks to improve efficiency in a target regression task by borrowing information from related external source dataset(s). Existing approaches achieve this by enforcing Euclidean proximity between the target and source regression parameters or, more recently, by encouraging their directional alignment through angle-based penalties. While such angle-based penalties mitigate the sensitivity of the transfer learning methods to the scale differences between source and target regression coefficients, they still rely on a point estimate of the source regression parameter and thus provide no direct mechanism to incorporate uncertainty in the source information. To that end, we propose a probabilistic framework for transfer learning that operates at the level of a \emph{scale-invariant directional distribution} of the source regression parameter estimate, rather than its point estimate, to enable robust, scale-invariant and uncertainty aware transfer under heterogeneous source information. Specifically, we project the sampling distribution of the source regression estimate onto the unit sphere, thereby extracting its scale-free directional distribution. Transfer from source to target is then induced through a novel \emph{angular cone prior} which shrinks the target regression parameter towards directions in which the source distribution assigns high probability, while allowing its magnitude to be learned exclusively from the target dataset. The proposed construction admits exact finite-sample characterizations of posterior angular concentration and posterior computation remains tractable via careful low-dimensional augmentation in the parameter space.

papers.title_en: Decision-Aligned Value Learning for Selective Adoption of EEG Fusion in Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.authors: Xinjia Yu, Jing Yang, Yang Zhou, Tielin Shi, Tao Cheng
papers.evidence: 用于人机协作决策的选择性EEG融合
papers.tldr: 本研究针对人机协作中 EEG 证据样本级效用不均问题，提出 VECTA 框架，通过估计系统增益和价值学习，在预算约束下选择性地采用 EEG 融合预测替换基础预测，实验显示其能降低损失和有害采用，且可事后应用无需重训练。
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) captures neural activity associated with human perception and decision-making. It provides human-robot collaboration (HRC) systems with measurable evidence for event recognition, situation assessment, and action preparation. External sensing cannot easily provide such evidence. However, the quality and complementarity of this evidence vary across samples, and existing EEG fusion methods do not explicitly determine when EEG improves a prediction. We therefore framed selective EEG use as a sample-wise incremental-value estimation problem and proposed Value Estimation and Constraint-Aware Triage for Adoption (VECTA). VECTA separates the generation of an EEG-informed Fusion prediction from the decision about whether it should replace the existing Base prediction. The framework uses system gain to quantify the loss reduction from Base to Fusion and matching gain to assess whether benefits arise from sample-matched EEG. A signed-value learner estimates system gain from decision-time evidence and prioritizes high-value Fusion outputs under budget constraints. Cross-subject evaluations on three HRC datasets showed that matched Fusion outperformed shuffled controls. Estimated gains tracked realized gains, with Spearman correlations of 0.347-0.612 and positive-gain areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROCs) of 0.708-0.842. Under budget constraints, VECTA reduced Brier loss and harmful Fusion adoption and achieved the highest mean normalized AUBC across three datasets among the selective-decision methods evaluated. Validation on three external multi-modal datasets showed that VECTA could be applied directly as a post-hoc decision layer to task-specific predictors without retraining. These results show that selective Fusion adoption can translate the uneven utility of EEG into system-level gains.
